app.rules_summary: Wordwank is a high-speed vocabulary duel! Use your tiles to form the highest scoring (or weirdest) word before time runs out. Letter values are based on their frequency in the wank sock: common letters are worth 1 point, while rarer letters earn progressively more (up to 9 points). The two rarest 'Unicorn' letters are worth 10 points! One letter each day is worth 7 points. Longer words earn Length Bonuses (+{{bonus_base}} for {{bonus_len}} letters, doubling for every letter after, so using all {{rack_size}} tiles earns +{{full_bonus}}). Careful: duplicating a word gives you 0 points, but if someone copies YOU, you earn the full raw letter value of that word — per copy. Every game, one tile mutates into the Mutant Letter — it glows green and is worth 10 points. Find it fast.
